workflow_runs.display_title: fix(testing): publish descriptor stream observation helper

head_commit.message:
fix(testing): publish descriptor stream observation helper

Add a descriptor-bound Redis event-stream reader for module integration suites.
Refuse foreign tenants before opening persistence and keep native test consumers
on the shared EventStore testing SDK.
